label: Flight Moment
description: Airframe-agnostic flight moments — drama written against air, light and terrain so any aircraft type can carry it.

items.name: vapor-pull
items.text: hauled through a hard turn, condensation blooming in sheets off the lifting surfaces and streaming from the tips

items.name: committed-low-pass
items.text: committed to a low pass down the display line, its own shadow rushing to meet it as the ground blurs beneath

items.name: cloud-surfing
items.text: skimming a solid cloud deck, wake carving a soft furrow while its shadow races alongside ringed by a glory

items.name: valley-run
items.text: threading a steep-walled valley below the ridgelines, banked against scree slopes that rise on either side

items.name: sun-cross
items.text: crossing the sun's disc as a hard black silhouette, flare spilling around the airframe's outline

items.name: crosswind-arrival
items.text: crabbed into a gusting crosswind just above the runway, wings rocking, a heartbeat from kicking straight

items.name: camera-ship-formation
items.text: holding tight formation with the camera ship, close enough to count fasteners, the horizon tilted behind it

items.name: mountain-departure
items.text: climbing hard away from a mountain strip, the terrain falling away beneath it in stacked ridgelines

items.name: rain-curtain-arrival
items.text: emerging from a grey curtain of rain into a shaft of clear light, wet skin gleaming along every panel line
items.text_short: breaking out of rain into light

items.name: golden-taxi
items.text: taxiing toward the threshold through drifting exhaust shimmer, a marshaller's silhouette guiding it between the wing tips
items.text_short: taxiing to the threshold, marshaller ahead
